title: termal_send_to_session idempotency keys are unique per sender across ALL recipients, but the tool text only says "sender-scoped", so fanning one message out to several peers with one key fails with 409
outcome: termal_send_to_session idempotency keys are unique per sender across ALL recipients, but the tool text only says "sender-scoped", so fanning one message out to several peers with one key fails with 409
acceptance: Either the key scope becomes (sender, recipient), so the same key may be reused for the same intent to different recipients (tests: same key + same body to two recipients both succeed; same key + different body to the same recipient still conflicts), OR the tool description, the MCP protocol text and the mailbox docs state plainly that a key is unique per sender across all recipients and recommend recipient-qualified keys for fan-out (doc test or review).
The 409 message names the existing message's recipient so the cause is obvious.
